title: AnkiLabs - Service Health
description: AnkiLabs request, upstream, deployment and resource health. Failures are observed 5xx or explicit upstream timeout/unavailable; read latency means next to their sample counts.

panels.title: Core metrics scrape health (absent target is unknown)
panels.description: AnkiLabs metrics targets (gateway, lookups, PostgreSQL exporter, AI Card Actions): 1 reachable, 0 failed. A missing row is unknown; AnkiLabsScrapeFailed and AnkiLabsExpectedTargetMissing alert on both.

panels.title: Available / desired AnkiLabs deployment replicas
panels.description: Available over desired replicas per AnkiLabs Deployment, from Kubernetes readiness. Below 1, check restarts, OOM kills and the warning logs below.

panels.title: Completed requests by service, route and HTTP status / 15 minutes
panels.description: Completed HTTP requests over 15 minutes per service, route and status. Counts come from counter increases and can be fractional; they are not an audit log.

panels.title: Observed server failures / 15 minutes
panels.description: Completed requests that returned 5xx over 15 minutes; any value fires AnkiLabsRequestFailure. Find the request in the trace logs below by time or request ID.

panels.title: Mean completed HTTP duration
panels.description: Includes recorded success and failure completions; compare sample count and status above. Missing/zero samples are not a zero-second response.

targets.expr: sum by (job, service, route) (increase({__name__=~"ankilabs_(api_gateway|sentence_lookup|dictionary_lookup)_http_request_duration_seconds_sum",namespace="ankilabs"}[15m])) / sum by (job, service, route) (increase({__name__=~"ankilabs_(api_gateway|sentence_lookup|dictionary_lookup)_http_request_duration_seconds_count",namespace="ankilabs"}[15m]))

panels.title: HTTP latency sample count / 15 minutes
panels.description: Completed requests behind each mean latency over 15 minutes. A mean from one or two requests is anecdotal; zero requests produce no mean.

panels.title: Gateway lookup upstream completions by status / 15 minutes
panels.description: Gateway calls to Sentence and Dictionary Lookup over 15 minutes by status. 5xx, timeout and unavailable are failures and fire AnkiLabsUpstreamFailure.

panels.title: Gateway lookup upstream mean duration
panels.description: Average gateway-to-lookup call time over 15 minutes; empty when there were no calls. When it rises, check the stages on Search & PostgreSQL.

targets.expr: sum by (service) (increase(ankilabs_api_gateway_upstream_request_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="ankilabs",service=~"Sentence Lookup|Dictionary Lookup"}[15m])) / sum by (service) (increase(ankilabs_api_gateway_upstream_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs",service=~"Sentence Lookup|Dictionary Lookup"}[15m]))

panels.title: Container working set / configured memory limit
panels.description: Working set as a percentage of the configured memory limit; containers without a limit have no line. Near 100% the container is OOM-killed.

targets.expr: 100 * max by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="ankilabs",container!="",container!="POD"}) / on (namespace, pod, container) (max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="ankilabs",resource="memory",unit="byte"}) > 0)

panels.title: Container CPU consumption
panels.description: CPU cores used per AnkiLabs container. Compare with request latency before changing resources.

panels.title: Recent OOM restarts (empty means none observed, not complete coverage)
panels.description: Containers whose last termination was an OOM kill and that restarted in the last 15 minutes (ApplicationOOMKilled). Empty means none observed, not complete coverage.

panels.title: Container restarts / 15 minutes
panels.description: Container restarts over the previous 15 minutes. Check OOM restarts and the warning logs for the cause.

panels.title: Core request trace: started, stage and completion breadcrumbs
panels.description: Started, stage and completed events from the gateway and lookups, filtered by the request_id variable (parsed at query time). A request killed before completing shows only started events and has no latency sample.

panels.title: Core warnings/errors and unparsed/unknown records
panels.description: Preserves raw records. These are log records, not a count of failed requests.

panels.title: HTTP failure counters since process start (not window counts)
panels.description: First failure can create a nonzero series before its first scrape, making increase look zero. Compare raw counters with logs. New scrape discovery can reveal historical failures.

panels.title: Lookup upstream failure counters since gateway process start
panels.description: Raw gateway counters of failed lookup calls (5xx, timeout, unavailable) since each gateway process started. They catch failures a 15-minute window can miss and reset when the gateway restarts.
